newsitem.title: INDIA: Mild earthquake rocks India, no injuries reported.
newsitem.headline: Mild earthquake rocks India, no injuries reported.

text.p: A mild earthquake shook western India overnight but there were no reports of injuries or damage, the Indian Meteorological Department said on Monday.
The tremor, which measured 4.5 on the Richter scale, struck the southern part of Gujarat state at 11:43 p.m. (1813 GMT) on Sunday, a department official said.
The epicentre was near Surat city, about 200 km (120 miles) north of the financial capital Bombay, the official said.
In 1993 a quake measuring 6.4 on the Richter scale devastated a large area of neighbouring Maharashtra state, killing between 10,000 and 22,000 people and leaving some 150,000 homeless.
